exposure: anomalous origin of the right coronary artery from the main pulmonary artery
cohort: A 2-month-old male infant diagnosed with anomalous origin of the right coronary artery from the main pulmonary artery.
finding: The infant underwent successful surgery for anomalous origin of the right coronary artery from the main pulmonary artery and did well post-operatively, suggesting early diagnosis may prevent cardiovascular complications.
